260132993_3f4ffcdc.text: The locus coeruleus (LC) is the main source of norepinephrine (NE) in the brain, modulates wakefulness, and is altered in stress- related disorders

260132993_b5ef6670.text: .Here, we combine single-cell-RNA-sequencing, neuroanatomy, and electrophysiology to build a map of galanin and its receptors in the mouse LC. We found that NE neurons express mRNA transcripts for galanin, >19 other neuropeptides (but Npy), and >30 neuropeptide receptors with Galr1 included at low levels. Selective activation of GalR1 inhibited the spontaneous activity of a subset of NE neurons possibly through the activation of Kv currents.
